# Grok Bot avatars

Public PNG assets for Grok Bot GitHub comment and pull request branding headers.

These files are branding headers for comments and pull requests. They are not application icons.

Official bot to character mapping (João’s branding):

| File | Bot role | Character |
|------|----------|-----------|
| developer.png | Developer | Edward Elric |
| code-reviewer.png | Code Reviewer | Shota Aizawa |
| quality-gate-specialist.png | Quality Gate Specialist | Uryuu Ishida |
| quality-gate-devsecops.png | Quality Gate DevSecOps | Young Zangetsu |
| ai-gate-reviewer.png | AI Gate Reviewer | Kisuke Urahara |
| pr-shepherd.png | PR Shepherd | Akon |
| qa-expert.png | QA Expert | Ragdoll |
| product-manager.png | Product Manager | Bulma |
| data-analytics.png | Data Analytics | Cortana |
| business-analyst.png | Business Analyst | Kurisu Makise |

Required GitHub header format:

```html
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joaobispo2077/avo/main/.github/bot-avatars/<file>.png" width="48" height="48" alt="Role (Character)" />

**Role** (Character)
```
